method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 时间流逝：一开始还是清晨，随后午后阳光斜射进窗户。
facts.anchor: For a while it’s still early morning, then afternoon sunshine is slanting through the windows

facts.fact: Hattie 吃了花生酱果冻三明治、喝下冰茶后，在浏览器里输入搜索词，找到她要找的那条讣告。
facts.anchor: she types a search into the internet browser, scanning through the headings until she finds the one she’s looking for.

facts.fact: 讣告显示 Ramsby 探长在两周多前去世，死因是“长期慢性疾病”，由一位前妻悼念。
facts.anchor: Detective Donald Ramsby died a little over two weeks ago.

facts.fact: Hattie 啪地合上笔记本电脑，几乎把它扔过房间。
facts.anchor: Hattie slaps the laptop shut. Almost hurls it across the room.

facts.fact: Hattie 对着空屋子说出“他可能在撒谎”。
facts.anchor: “He could’ve been lying,” she says to the empty house.

facts.fact: Hattie 花了十分钟追查 Bedfellow 案的首席法医技术员是谁，然后停下了。
facts.anchor: spends ten minutes researching who the lead forensic tech was for the Bedfellow case, then stops

facts.fact: Ramsby 只是把疑虑像接力赛中的接力棒一样交给了 Eeling，而现在这根接力棒到了 Hattie 手里。
facts.anchor: all Ramsby did was hand off the doubt to Eeling like a baton in a relay race.

facts.fact: Hattie 再次合上电脑、走进书房；天色由晴转暮，海鸟成群，海水湛蓝。
facts.anchor: She pulls the laptop shut again and goes to the den.

facts.fact: 敲门声让她猛地回神；她开门，等的不是 Eeling，而是一个鬼魂（她还一路想象过去四十八小时都是自己的妄想）。
facts.anchor: When she opens the door it’s not Eeling who waits there.
